home.faq1Q: How do I report a service issue?
home.faq1A: Register for free, then go to Submit Report. Choose the agency (REG, WASAC, or Emergency), select the service type, enter location and description. Your report will be tracked until resolution.
home.faq2Q: Will I get SMS alerts without internet?
home.faq2A: Yes. Opt-in to SMS alerts in your profile. You'll receive location-based notifications for service disruptions even on basic mobile phones.
home.faq3Q: How long until my report is resolved?
home.faq3A: Agencies aim to respond within 24–48 hours. You can track status (Received → In Progress → Resolved) in My Reports.
home.faq4A: ServicePulse is built for Rwanda first, with architecture designed for expansion across East Africa.

about.title: About ServicePulse
about.missionText: ServicePulse is a centralized, multi-channel public service communication platform designed to bridge the digital divide in Rwanda. We connect citizens with essential government services through SMS and web-based channels, ensuring that critical information reaches everyone, regardless of internet connectivity.
about.challengeText: Digital access inequality remains a significant barrier in Rwanda and across East Africa. While internet penetration is growing, many citizens still rely on basic mobile phones without consistent internet access. ServicePulse addresses this by combining SMS-based notifications with modern web dashboards, ensuring no citizen is left behind.
about.solutionText: ServicePulse provides a unified platform where:
about.solution1: Citizens receive location-based SMS alerts for service disruptions
about.solution2: Citizens can submit service reports via web interface
about.solution3: Government agencies manage alerts and view aggregated reports
about.solution4: Hotspot identification helps prioritize service improvements
about.visionText: ServicePulse is designed with scalability in mind. Our architecture supports expansion across East Africa, with plans for additional service types, advanced analytics, and automated response systems. This platform represents a foundation for digital governance that prioritizes accessibility and citizen engagement.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Create a free account with your email, phone number, and location. Accept the terms and conditions to get started.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Opt-in to SMS alerts and choose which service types you want to receive notifications for (Electricity, Water, Emergency).
howItWorks.step3Desc: Get location-based SMS notifications when service disruptions occur in your area. No internet required.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Report service issues through the web dashboard. Track the status of your reports from submission to resolution.
howItWorks.agencyStep1Desc: Agency users receive dashboard access for their specific service (REG, WASAC, or Emergency Services).
howItWorks.agencyStep2Desc: Create targeted SMS notifications by service type and location. Preview messages before sending to all eligible citizens.
howItWorks.agencyStep3Desc: Access the reports inbox to see all citizen-submitted issues. Filter by location, service type, or status.
howItWorks.agencyStep4Desc: Update report status (Received → In Progress → Resolved) and identify service hotspots through location clustering.
